text_block_list.text:
After some time off, Narita Taishin stops
by my
office.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's none of your... Ugh, I guess it
is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Same ol', same ol'. I took it easy and
spent my
time relaxing.

It seems like Narita Taishin had a good
break.
